newsitem.title: UK: Caradon ups Weru stake to 71.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Caradon ups Weru stake to 71.9 pct.

text.p: Caradon Plc said on Wednesday it had increased its holding in German window and door manufacturer Weru AG to 71.9 percent following the purchase of further shares in the company on Tuesday.
On Monday Caradon increased its stake to 64.8 percent from 50.1 percent.
"In order to strengthen and maximise the benefits of the current cooperation, Caradon is considering entering into domination and profit transfer agreements with Weru," it said in a statement.
"The purchase is an important further step in the implementation of the board's strategy to create one of Europe's leading doors and windows businesses," Caradon chief executive Peter Jansen said.
